title: Connecting Ideas in Writing
text:
Connectors help readers follow the logic of a text. For example, 'however' signals a contrast, while 'therefore' introduces a result. Many students use the same few connectors in every essay. As a result, their writing can sound repetitive and simple.

Good writers, on the other hand, vary their connectors according to their purpose. Instead of repeating 'and' or 'but', they might use 'moreover' to add information or 'nevertheless' to show a surprising contrast. Practice with a variety of connectors makes writing clearer and more interesting. Teachers often recommend this habit to advanced learners.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what does the word 'however' signal?
According to paragraph two, what do good writers do?
options: They vary their connectors according to their purpose
They use only very formal words

questions.text: What can be inferred about the writer's view of repeating the same few connectors?
options: It makes writing less clear and less interesting
It is required in academic exams

questions.text: Why would a teacher recommend practising a variety of connectors?
options: To help advanced learners write more clearly

paragraph_translations: Los conectores ayudan a los lectores a seguir la lógica de un texto. Por ejemplo, 'however' indica un contraste, mientras que 'therefore' introduce un resultado. Muchos estudiantes usan los mismos pocos conectores en todos sus ensayos. Como resultado, su escritura puede sonar repetitiva y simple.

Los buenos escritores, en cambio, varían sus conectores según su propósito. En lugar de repetir 'and' o 'but', pueden usar 'moreover' para añadir información o 'nevertheless' para mostrar un contraste sorprendente. La práctica con una variedad de conectores hace que la escritura sea más clara e interesante. Los profesores suelen recomendar este hábito a los estudiantes avanzados.
